summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Autohome Inc. announcing the results of its annual general meeting held on June 23, 2026. Shareholders approved a special resolution to amend and restate the memorandum and articles of association, and ordinary resolutions to re-elect five directors. No extraordinary transactions, offers, or special situations are present; it is a routine corporate governance filing. The filing does not disclose any deal terms, advisor involvement, or event beyond standard AGM business. As a routine meeting result announcement, it does not constitute a special-situation event.
